note: Exporter identity and address match: ImportKey lists "B H NEW NIRMA PHASE 4,PLOT NO 3751 VATVA GIDC" (Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat), consistent with the Ahmedabad ICD / Ahmedabad Air ACC port lanes. Declared HS 841410;841490 matches the actual shipment codes 84141090 (liquid ring vacuum pumps) and 84149090 (parts of pumps/compressors) — no HS correction needed. Industry claim "IT и электроника" is wrong: the company manufactures liquid ring vacuum pumps, compressors, pulp/stock pumps and refiners for the paper industry — industrial machinery, not IT/electronics. Export activity is confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destinations USA and Czech Republic; the page also shows Russia-related lanes ("ST PETERSBURG EX LE" 44 records) and a China supplier (ZIBO YINFENG MACHINERY) indicating two-way trade. Domestic supply evidence is null — GST turnover, GeM/CPPP participation and revenue figures are not public in the sources reachable within the call budget; no numbers invented. Caveat: the 319-shipment figure is the aggregator's own counter and was not independently reconciled; only 5 individual records were actually read.
